item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a single internal cabinet memo, staffing audit, or formal personnel evaluation that directly measures Jokowi’s appointment quality across the whole state. The judgment here is therefore inferential, based on high-signal public cases: technocratic continuity in macro/health policy on the positive side, and patronage-driven party/cabinet moves on the negative side.","evidence":[{"title":"Sri Mulyani strength and continuity in the finance ministry","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-12","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/publications/fandd/issues/2024/12/trenches-relentless-reformer-sri-mulyani-indrawati","summary":"IMF says Sri Mulyani strengthened macro foundations, broadened the tax base, capped subsidies, and enforced high standards. That is strong evidence Jokowi kept a highly capable technocrat empowered at the center of government.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.2"]},{"title":"Indonesia’s robust macro framework helped attract investment","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-06-24","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/06/24/indonesia-economy-projected-to-remain-resilient","summary":"The World Bank credited Indonesia’s credible macro framework and called for continued prudent, transparent policy. This supports a reading that Jokowi empowered technocratic economic managers rather than only loyal operators.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.2"]},{"title":"BI raised rates preemptively to defend stability","publisher":"Bank Indonesia","date":"2024-04-30","url":"https://www.bi.go.id/en/publikasi/laporan/Pages/Laporan-Kebijakan-Moneter-Triwulan-I-2024.aspx","summary":"Bank Indonesia used a preemptive rate hike and other monetary tools to defend the rupiah and keep inflation in target. That suggests Jokowi’s economic system still ran through competent, technically capable institutions.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.2"]},{"title":"Health-system execution through professionalized processes","publisher":"WHO","date":"2024-12-06","url":"https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240100893","summary":"WHO says JKN expanded access and financial protection, while Mobile JKN simplified enrollment and payments. This is good evidence that Jokowi backed capable administrative implementers in a major social program.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"Rapid-response teams in 514 districts","publisher":"WHO Indonesia","date":"2024-08-30","url":"https://www.who.int/indonesia/news-room/item/30-08-2024-indonesia-ramps-up-capacities-to-detect-and-respond-to-outbreaks-of-emerging-and-epidemic-prone-diseases","summary":"The Ministry of Health and WHO trained rapid-response teams nationwide for detection, verification, field investigation, risk assessment, and outbreak response. This is concrete evidence of empowering capable implementers for a public-good program.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.2"]},{"title":"Golkar installed a Jokowi loyalist as party leader","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-08-21","url":"https://theprint.in/world/indonesias-golkar-party-picks-influential-jokowis-top-loyalist-as-leader/2231679/","summary":"Reuters reported that Jokowi’s loyalist took over Golkar and that this could preserve Jokowi’s influence after office. That is direct evidence of network control and loyalty-based selection, not just competence-based staffing.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3"]},{"title":"Cabinet jobs for Prabowo loyalists","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-08-19","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/outgoing-indonesian-president-widodo-names-prabowo-aides-to-cabinet-3576652","summary":"Jokowi used a late-term reshuffle to place people close to Prabowo into cabinet roles, framed as transition-smoothing. Reuters’ framing points to political brokerage and network management rather than a pure merit test.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3"]},{"title":"Patronage and dynastic politics as defining features","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-10-14","url":"https://theprint.in/world/analysis-a-decade-of-jokowi-indonesias-democracy-icon-leaves-illiberal-legacy-critics-say/2310394/","summary":"Reuters’ end-of-term analysis says Jokowi left behind patronage, dynastic politics, and weaker institutional integrity. That is broad background evidence that personnel choices were not cleanly meritocratic.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3","7B.9"]},{"title":"Election-law push seen as family-advantage politics","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-08-22","url":"https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesia-shelves-plan-revise-election-law-protests-rage-2024-08-22/","summary":"Reuters reported that planned rule changes were widely seen as helping Jokowi’s youngest son and consolidating family advantage. This does not prove poor competence, but it strongly suggests loyalty and kinship outweighed neutral capability criteria.","question_ids":["8B.4","4B.2","7B.9"]},{"title":"State information-control apparatus was mobilized for election monitoring","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/indonesia/freedom-net/2024","summary":"Freedom House says Bawaslu, Kominfo, KPU, and police cyber units formed a task force to monitor and remove content. That shows Jokowi’s state apparatus could be mobilized effectively, but the function was coercive and overbroad rather than cleanly competence-based public administration.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3","4B.6"]},{"title":"Weak accountability in Papua despite security machinery","publisher":"U.S. Department of State","date":"published 2025-08-12; covers 2024","url":"https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2128570.html","summary":"The report says abuses continued in Papua and the government did not systematically investigate or punish officials. That is negative evidence that Jokowi did not sufficiently empower accountable, professionally disciplined security officials.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3","4B.2"]},{"title":"Project favoritism persisted inside Jokowi-era implementation","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-07-10","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/07/10/world-bank-group-debars-pt-lppslh-konsultan","summary":"The World Bank found overbilling and improper hiring of a project official’s family member. This is not proof of Jokowi’s direct instruction, but it is strong evidence that non-merit favoritism persisted inside state-linked implementation.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.2","7B.9"]}]}
